description: Hold-out genuine case, written blind from the brief's family description. The message is simulated and the people in it are illustrative. A buyer says a parcel the carrier marks delivered never reached them.

messages.subject: Basket marked delivered but not here
messages.body: The tracking for order KIK-1013 says delivered, but I never got it. I've asked at the reception of my building and they have nothing. Could you look into it and refund me if it's lost?
